rdfs:label: Thing
rdfs:comment: The OWL universal class — the class of all individuals; every OWL class is a subclass of it. Not the same as schema.org's `Thing`, which is a concrete root class with its own properties.
notes: The universal class — every individual is implicitly a `Thing`. Rarely used as an explicit `@type`; mostly relevant in OWL reasoning. This term is `owl:Thing` only. `https://schema.org/Thing` (in seeAlso) is a different, concrete class — the root of Schema.org's hierarchy, carrying properties like `name`, `url` and `description`; reference its full IRI when you mean it.

examples.title: Every Agent is a Thing (OWL reasoning)

history.note: Mapped to owl:Thing only; schema:Thing kept as seeAlso only (removed from provenance); comment/notes/example rewritten for OWL reasoning.
